transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: Namaste, I want to apply for the Old Age Pension. My name is Sundari Bai, born 10/04/1956 in Lakhipur village, Sonari block. My bank account is 3876903950095 with IFSC SBIN0003077.

response.assistant_instruction: Read the preview and declaration aloud to the citizen. Call submit_application ONLY after receiving their explicit confirmation.

transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: Yes, all details are correct. I agree to the declaration.

response.message_hi: Aapka aavedan kramank SSP26696747 safaltapoorvak jama ho gaya hai.
response.tracking_instruction: You can track your application anytime using your mobile number and date of birth (DDMMYYYY).

results.what_changed_because_of_eval: Configured server-side confirmation token pattern to prevent accidental submission before reading declaration.

results.name: Ramlal

transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: Hello, I am Ramlal from Dighaljan. My date of birth is 15/08/1968. Please submit my pension form.

errors: applicant must be 60 years of age or above
response.next_questions: Please ask the citizen to correct the following items: applicant must be 60 years of age or above

results.what_changed_because_of_eval: Harmonized exact date math in services.age_on so DOB 59 years 364 days cannot bypass the 60-year rule.

results.name: Fatima Begum

transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: I want to apply for my pension again, just in case.

response.message: You already hold an active application (SSP26888123: PENDING). Only one active pension is permitted.
response.message_hi: Aapka pehle se ek aavedan darj hai (SSP26888123: PENDING).
response.next_step: If this was an error, you may withdraw your pending application first.

results.what_changed_because_of_eval: Added active_application check at both prepare and submit stages to prevent duplicate submissions from parallel taps.

results.name: Kamla Devi

transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: My pending application has the wrong bank digits. I want to withdraw it.

response.warning: Are you sure you want to withdraw application SSP26444123? Once withdrawn, you can submit a new application.
response.warning_hi: Kya aap aavedan SSP26444123 vapas lena chahte hain? Iske baad aap naya aavedan jama kar sakenge.
response.instruction: Call withdraw_application with confirm=True to proceed.

response.message_hi: Aapka aavedan safaltapoorvak vapas le liya gaya hai. Aap naya aavedan kar sakte hain.

results.what_changed_because_of_eval: Allowed immediate re-application upon withdrawal by filtering active statuses to ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'DEEMED_APPROVED').

results.name: Gopal Das

transcript.speaker: citizen
transcript.text: My account number is 123456 and IFSC is INVALID.

errors: bank account number must be 9 to 18 digits
IFSC must be 11 characters, e.g. SBIN0003077
